The driver never came at all. I wait at my condo guardhouse almost 15 minutes, call him also cannot get through, then he cancel and charge me $8! Eight dollars for a car that never turned up. I want my money back and I want somebody to call me about this.

Reviewer view: the judge's full reasoning

This was a verified no-show: the SGD 8.00 cancellation fee stands and the driver is paid SGD 6.40.

What the record shows. The driver's 10-second GPS trace (EV-GPS-00208) puts his vehicle inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius at The Interlace guardhouse from 16:02:10, and he held position there continuously for 585 seconds until 16:11:55 — 285 seconds more than the 300-second free waiting period in force for this RYDE_XL trip under the trip record's platform policy (EV-TRIP-00208). The 'arrived' marker at 16:02:25 sits inside that run with only 15 seconds of skew, and the trip was terminated by the driver at 16:12:10 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW — one of the three codes POL-NS-01(d) recognises — with no boarding event. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold, and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces them.

How to appeal: You may appeal once within 30 days (POL-GEN-04). A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 6.40 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

This was a verified no-show: the SGD 8.00 cancellation fee stands and the driver is paid SGD 6.40. What the record shows. The 'arrived' marker at 16:02:25 sits inside that run with only 15 seconds of skew, and the trip was terminated by the driver at 16:12:10 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW — one of the three codes POL-NS-01(d) recognises — with no boarding event. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold, and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces them. Rider, on your account. Your statement that the driver never came is not borne out, and your advocate rightly did not press it. Your own device track (EV-GPS-00208) never moves and stays 634–646 m from the pickup pin, with zero qualifying fixes inside the 150 m rider-presence radius — you were not at the guardhouse pickup point while the driver waited. POL-NS-04 therefore does not exonerate you: limb (b) fails because the driver replied 18 seconds after your 16:08:02 message and placed an answered 34-second in-app call at 16:09:40 (EV-CHAT-00208, EV-TRIP-00208), and limb (c) fails on your own fixes. POL-NS-06 cannot help you, because the dwell exceeded the free waiting period, and no traffic advisory exists to change that (EV-ADVIS-00208-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT). Your reading of POL-NS-01's 'fixes inside the radius' sentence is rejected: read with the clause's own note, that sentence is the in-radius DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE outcome only, and the driver here used RIDER_NO_SHOW. The arrival marker was not false — the driver was stationary 28.8 m from the pin at 0 km/h — so POL-NS-05 does not fire and the waiting clock runs from the genuine arrival. Because the clauses do license an outcome, there is no gap for POL-GEN-07 to fill and no basis for escalation. Driver compensation and the profiles. Because the fee is chargeable and nothing displaces it, POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80% of the SGD 8.00 fee — SGD 6.40 — the residual 20% retained as the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2 (below 4) and 2/143 = 0.014 (below 0.08), and both limbs must be met. Under POL-GEN-03 a ruling that pays the driver is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, and amount_sgd carries the same figure, SGD 6.40. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: the admissible artifacts agree with one another, there is no shared-party dispute history, the anti-farming check is not tripped, and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1 (below 3). Your prior_no_show_flags of 3, your rating, cancellation rate and prior dispute counters are context only under POL-GEN-01 and are not used as a ground against you. Integrity and confidence. The deciding facts rest on artifacts of full weight (1.0), so confidence is set at 0.95. Referrals and next steps. Your request for someone to call you is noted in this ruling; it does not itself create a referral, but you retain the right to ask for a human decision (POL-GEN-08(3)) and the appeal route under POL-GEN-04.
